entities.name: UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu-DAP ligase
observations: Sequence-based identification is homology-supported: 57.0% identity and 97.7% query coverage to reviewed UniProt Q9RNM2 (EC 6.3.2.13).
Catalyzes addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu in bacterial peptidoglycan precursor biosynthesis; Mg2+ is annotated as cofactor.
